fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Running tests emitted a noisy `DeprecationWarning: pkg_resources is deprecated as an API` warning originating entirely from third-party packages in `.venv` (pytest monkeypatch, babel, werkzeug). No project code uses `pkg_resources` directly.

## What changed

Added one `filterwarnings` entry to `pytest.ini` to suppress the warning, exactly matching the existing pattern used for `flask_restx` and `flask_babel`:

```ini
    # https://github.com/PennyDreadfulMTG/Penny-Dreadful-Tools/issues/11249
    ignore:.*pkg_resources is deprecated.*:DeprecationWarning
```

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- Unit tests were env-blocked in this cloud workspace (conftest.py requires a live database connection on collection, which was unavailable); however the change is a 2-line config-only suppression with no code logic to test.

Fixes #11249
